name: Oliver Vertran
source:
A young man who spends years trying to find clues in order to bring justice for his mother's tragic murder. Over the course of his investigation, Oliver will have to come to terms with many issues in his life as he discovers the history of his family while also attending classes at the local Academy.

[spoiler]Oliver's guardian, Kristian Orvood, is also his mother's killer. Kristian saw an immense potential in him to be the perfect Orvood family's successor, so he bought Oliver from his mother in order to raise him as his own son.[/spoiler]
